facts.text: Eros Regolith Boulder Field was deployed at 433 Eros — Himeros Region during NEAR Shoemaker in 2001.
Pristine rubble-strewn asteroid terrain composed of ancient chondritic breccia, shattered ejecta blocks, and smooth flat dust ponds.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Revealed electrostatic levitation of ultra-fine dust grains into low depressions without atmosphere or liquid flow.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at 433 Eros — Himeros Region.
Uncovered electrostatic dust transport mechanisms now observed across airless worlds.
